dimensions.summary: The in-memory reference composer preserves the admitted fact, ontology, proof, quality and one-way Graph truth contracts.
Composition sources, facts, edges, worker output and time are explicitly bounded through policy and fixed safety ceilings.
CPU-heavy reference composition executes through an explicit worker port and a real Node worker while the host event loop remains responsive.
Worker omission, duplication, mutation, injection, budget abuse, identity collision, evidence amplification and majority voting fail closed.
Composition remains in memory, accepts portable admitted inputs and publishes neither internal governance material nor machine-local paths.
Local Node worker and packed consumption pass; same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G2 evidence remains required.
The root composer is host-neutral, the Node worker is explicit by subpath and the central CLI remains outside the package runtime.
Canonical generation identity is invariant to source order and temporal evaluation while every admitted fact is accounted for exactly once.
The versioned portable worker task can be implemented by later native or WASM adapters without moving identity, proof or authority semantics.
Cancellation, timeout, unsupported tasks, worker crash, invalid transport and resource exhaustion produce non-publishable typed outcomes.
Reference semantics, execution ports, host adapter, adversarial properties and governance state have package-owned executable evidence.
A separately packed consumer executes the real worker subpath while source, tests, scripts, governance and source maps remain excluded.

checks.evidence: Contracts, types, lint, formatting, coverage, build, real worker execution, installed tarball and admission integrity pass.
Shared and Graph checks plus permanent quality, boundary and mirror guards pass.
Same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows G2 composition evidence is not yet retained.

remainingRisks: The same signed commit must retain successful Linux, Windows and macOS composition evidence before G2 approval.
N-ary composition remains gated by proposed ADR-0012; the current G2 closure makes no n-ary materialization claim.
Rust, native and WASM acceleration remain prohibited until G6 measurements justify a parity-checked adapter.
Query, persistence, incremental execution, stable publication and CLI replacement remain governed by later stages.

approval.rule: A signed maintainer checkpoint plus retained same-commit Linux, Windows and macOS G2 evidence authorizes G3 only.
